material.constitutive_model: full 3D isotropic small-strain elasticity, lambda and mu

semantic_layout.base_columns: sorted source_ids, each source has ux,uy,uz, SOURCE_BASE, basis_index 0
semantic_layout.global_columns: GLOBAL_FRONT owner global, branch-major 1..4, each branch has ux,uy,uz
semantic_layout.source_local_405_layout: separate diagnostic scope; never used as this 93-DOF registry

global_branch_basis.coefficient_note: Derived from mixed_lefm_field.py angular formulas using c*cos(theta)=c-F3 and s*cos(theta)=-s+F4.

integration_cache_selection.volume_cloud: frozen a0 theta32, 4 radial x 32 angular x 4 z = 512 rows
integration_cache_selection.cap_cloud: frozen a0 cap16, both caps together, 512 rows
integration_cache_selection.cached_mls_selection: cloud unique_row_ids index base_mls_values and base_mls_gradients_per_m; append four branch functions in this script
integration_cache_selection.analytic_evaluations: Evaluate field and four global branches only at these already cached xyz rows; no provider call.
integration_cache_selection.boundary_load: full traction sigma*n on side and both end caps; no projection or dropped components
integration_cache_selection.volume_stiffness: raw K=sum(w*B.T*D*B), no symmetrization, ridge, pseudoinverse, or mode truncation

rigid_gauge.definition: six physical volume moments: V^-1 integral [u_x,u_y,u_z, ((x-center) cross u)/R] dV
rigid_gauge.target: g=C_phys*q_exact, computed separately for each manufactured load; preserve nonzero g and g dot lambda
rigid_gauge.coefficient_rigid_modes_role: frozen six coefficient vectors are used only to qualify six null modes and physical-gauge coupling rank

limitations: Cached study is an a0 theta32 quadrature benchmark, not a convergence proof.
Manufactured LEFM fields and the E=1 MPa toy material are numerical checks, not ceramic data.
No crack advance, material law, or autonomous fracture qualification is implemented.
